meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

copy.tagline: 处理化学分子数据，计算描述符和指纹。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在药物发现中处理分子结构并计算属性。
copy.tagline_en: Process chemical molecular data, compute descriptors and fingerprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle molecular structures and compute properties in drug discovery.

howto.what: 安装 datamol 后，Claude 能用 datamol 库处理化学分子：解析 SMILES、标准化结构、计算理化描述符、生成分子指纹、聚类、产生 3D 构象等。所有分子对象都是原生 RDKit 类型。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行分子格式转换、描述符计算、指纹生成、聚类分析或 3D 构象生成等药物发现任务时触发。

say.note: 默认 Tanimoto 距离阈值 0.2。

howto.what_en: After installing datamol, Claude can use the library for molecular cheminformatics: parse SMILES, standardize structures, compute descriptors, generate fingerprints, cluster molecules, and generate 3D conformers. All molecular objects are native RDKit types.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests molecule format conversion, descriptor calculation, fingerprint generation, clustering analysis, or 3D conformer generation for drug discovery tasks.

Generate 3D conformers for this molecule and visualize.
